purpose: Regression examples for ownership and negation, inspired by public feedback supplied by the project owner. Evaluation only; not a new independent benchmark or training data.

feedback_sources.author: Akshat | MagnetX (@aksenHQ)
feedback_sources.contribution: Asked what rule would preserve the object's owner.

feedback_sources.author: Aliii (@drunk_vibecoder)
feedback_sources.contribution: Suggested the three Return/Don't lend examples and separate ownership, negation, and politeness checks.

review_dimensions: ownership: preserve the original owner and the speaker/addressee perspective
negation: preserve whether the requested action is positive or prohibited
politeness: make a polite request rather than commenting on or refusing the task
action: preserve the original action and object without inventing context
